Reason: SKILL.md says "finally call saveExpenseDoc to save the draft", but it does not explicitly constrain "the docStatus parameter must be fixed to '10'". The model infers parameter values on its own and sometimes passes "20" (submit for approval), directly submitting documents the user never reviewed. Fix: add one sentence to the rules: "docStatus must be fixed to '10', corresponding to the draft state; passing other values will cause the document to directly enter the approval flow and cannot be withdrawn" — after adding the "why", the probability of correct model execution improves significantly.
